Messages.Author: Jarrod P. Stenberg
Messages.Body:
Has anyone put together a compilation of complete (and accurate) Advanced
game rules with V:TES changes? If I wasn't so busy, I'd just sit down and
type my own functional rulebook--Splitting the rulebook into Basic and
Advanced games without a full independent set of Advanced rules was a darn
silly idea.

I'll ask even more...is there a complete listing of Rulings and Errata for
the whole Jyhad/V:TES/Dark Sovereigns?

Brian
sago...@maroon.tc.umn.edu

URL:http://www.math.sc.edu/~sjohnson/jyhad/errata.txt
URL:http://www.math.sc.edu/~sjohnson/jyhad/errata.ds.txt
